info.name: HealthyLife AI — Patient App
info.description:
PATIENT APP ONLY: every call the Flutter patient app makes (the nutritionist/dashboard endpoints are in API_CONTRACT.md).

1. Set `username` and `password` (the generated password the nutritionist sent) in the collection variables.
2. Run Auth > Login: tokens are saved automatically.
3. Run Consent > Get, then Accept, before any data call.
Requests that create something save its id for the next request.

request.description: 200 user + tokens (user has username and password_is_temporary) · 401 wrong username/password · 423 locked (locked_until) · 403 follow_up_ended · 429. The username is case-insensitive. {phone, password} still works temporarily; do not build on it.
Single use: every call returns a NEW pair. Re-using an old refresh token revokes every session.
User object: id, name, phone, role, nutritionist_id, subscriber_id, gender, patient_code, username, password_is_temporary, avatar_url.
DEPRECATED: no new links are issued; only links sent before the username release still work (7 days). 422 WITH errors.password = weak password; 422 WITHOUT errors = link invalid/expired/used.
Returns a NEW token pair and password_is_temporary = false; every other session ends. Not behind the consent gate.
Always 200. Clear the FCM token first (Device > Clear FCM token).

exec: try { const v = j.current_version; if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set('consent_version', String(v)); } catch (e) {}

request.description: 201 first time · 200 already accepted · 409 consent_version_mismatch.
200 plan · 204 no active plan yet. Every food carries allergens and shopping_section. Saves the first planned item's id and food id.
q >= 2 chars; substring match, whole words first. Paginated {data, links, meta}.
201 new log.

exec: try { const v = j.id; if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set('meal_log_id', String(v)); } catch (e) {}

request.description: Same idempotency_key → 200 with the EXISTING log (no duplicate).

exec: try { const v = j.id; if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set('meal_log_id', String(v)); } catch (e) {}

request.description: 15 per page, newest first. from/to are dates in the clinic time zone (not UTC) and must be sent together.
Also logged_at (max 7-day move) or meal_type (off-plan only). 403 log_locked 7 days after the log reached the server.

201 new self-reported reading · 200 your own reading of that date updated (or replay). A clinic reading of the same date is never touched. weight_kg required. recorded_at is checked against the clinic's today.

exec: try { const v = j.id; if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set('reading_id', String(v)); } catch (e) {}

request.description: Plain array, oldest first.
204 · 403 reading_not_deletable (clinic) · 403 log_locked.
Default: last 7 days (clinic time zone).

exec: if (j[0]) { pm.collectionVariables.set('review_id', String(j[0].id)); if (j[0].tasks[0]) pm.collectionVariables.set('task_id', String(j[0].tasks[0].id)); }

request.description: 20 per page, newest updated first. unread=1 (not 'true'). Types include proposal_decided, appointment_cancelled, appointment_rescheduled.

exec: try { const v = j.data[0].id; if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set('notification_id', String(v)); } catch (e) {}

goal_type: weight_loss, weight_gain, muscle_gain, weight_maintenance, health_energy, medical_condition, other. The proposal comes back with the submitted data as payload.

try { const v = j.id; if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set('proposal_id', String(v)); } catch (e) {}

type: follow_up | results_review | quick_consult. Response carries type. Saves the first free time.

exec: try { const v = (j.days[0] || {times: []}).times[0]; if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set('slot_starts_at', String(v)); } catch (e) {}

request.description: Run 'Free slots' first. 422 appointment_locked within 12 h (carries nutritionist_whatsapp).
Returns the appointment with status cancelled. 422 appointment_locked within 12 h.
204 deletes the account and ALL data. Use a throwaway test patient only.
